methods.explanation: At an \(x\)-axis intersection, \(y=0\). Substituting into the given equation leaves \(x/4=1\), so \(x=4\). Therefore the \(x\)-intercept is \(4\).
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary coordinate geometry and multiplication of both sides of an equation by 4.
